title: Object and section record model, and the identifiers that survive deletion

sections.text: An object is the durable knowledge aggregate and holds coherent sections. A section's text is its current confirmed wording: there is no competing current-text field and no stored staleness verdict.

Object identifiers are UUIDv7 and resolve by unique prefix. Section identifiers are monotonic integers scoped to their object and are never reused, so deleting a section cannot silently retarget a reference that named it.
